data.historical_reuse: Old validation was previously used for fitting; old design/test were inspected. This is a retrospective study.
data.pixel_preprocessing: Real JPEGs: center-crop178, PIL bilinear-antialiased resize64, ToTensor times255 rounded uint8; generated verified uint8 shards; trainer maps to [-1,1].
data.feature_preprocessing: Frozen pytorch-fid 0.3.0 pool3 2048; fit standardization using training rows only.

role_definitions.earlystop: Half expanded validation; checkpoint selection only
role_definitions.selection_calibration: Quarter expanded validation; cell RDR estimates
role_definitions.selection_evaluation: Quarter expanded validation; candidate Brier and local Gap
role_definitions.test_calibration: Reserved half of expanded final pool; not loaded for model selection
role_definitions.test_evaluation: Reserved other half of expanded final pool; not loaded for model selection

checkpoint_rule: Minimum stopping-set balanced Brier, restored before selection scoring
selection_rule: Paired one-SE Brier shortlist, then minimum supported local absolute gap; support>=.99 each repeat
sensitivity_rule: Not included: fixed-architecture loss/activation selection only
test_scope: Reserved retrospective calibration/evaluation pool; exact counts in data metadata; never used by selection
ci_scope: Nominal image-level cell-average intervals; no identity-cluster, neural-mean, or candidate-selection uncertainty correction
repeat_scope: Initialization and ordering variation conditional on fixed real/generated samples; not independent-data uncertainty
